How many votes were cast for president in Wisconsin in 2016?
SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'WISCONSIN' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2016'
What kinds of legal entity own trademarks most often?
SELECT own_entity_desc, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_entity_desc <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did section 527 political groups report raising in July 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions WHERE substr(cast(column16 AS varchar), 1, 6) = '202407'
Which companies hold the most cellular licences?
SELECT column07 AS licensee, count(DISTINCT column04) AS call_signs FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_en WHERE uls_file = 'l_cell.zip' AND column05 = 'L' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Georgia's 2020 presidential vote was cast by mail?

SELECT mode, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'GEORGIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In which states do renters spend the largest share of income on rent?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS rent_pct_of_income FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25071' AND a.variable = 'B25071_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much more does a 64-year-old pay than a 21-year-old for marketplace coverage in Georgia? (2021)

SELECT age, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_monthly_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'GA' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021' AND age IN ('21', '64') AND tobacco <> 'Tobacco User' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Where was unemployment lowest among the states at the end of 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many patents has the USPTO withdrawn after granting them?
SELECT count(*) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE cast(withdrawn AS varchar) IN ('1', 'true', 'True')
Which cities are served by the most separate water systems?

SELECT concat(city_served, ', ', state_served), count(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_geographic_areas WHERE city_served IS NOT NULL AND concat(city_served, ', ', state_served) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. patents are design patents rather than utility patents?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of patent ownership change are recorded most often?
SELECT convey_ty, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment_conveyance GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rules on the fall 2024 agenda were expected to be major rules?
SELECT count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' AND major = 'Yes'
Which industries released the most toxic chemicals into the air in 2022?

SELECT _23_industry_sector AS industry, round(sum(try_cast(_51_51_fugitive_air AS double) + try_cast(_52_52_stack_air AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much stock did insiders sell on the open market in 2023, in dollars?

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(trans_pricepershare AS double))) AS dollars_sold FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans WHERE trans_code = 'S' AND trans_date LIKE '%-2023'
In which languages does ChEBI give the most international nonproprietary names?
SELECT language_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'INN' AND language_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people in the Bronx live below the poverty line?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36005' AND variable = 'B17001_E002'
Which therapeutic areas draw the most industry research payments?

SELECT product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 <> '' AND product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pages does a government form run on average?
SELECT avg(pages) AS average FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE pages > 0
Which companies hold the most approved drug products?
SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of patents carry a terminal disclaimer that limits their term?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(term_disclaimer <> '') / count(*), 1) AS pct_disclaimed FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_term_of_grant
Outside the United States, which countries host the most NIH-funded projects?
SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was ERCOT's peak hourly electricity demand in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.ERCO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '2023%'
What were the largest withdrawals from the Treasury's cash account over fiscal 2024?

SELECT transaction_catg, try_cast(transaction_fytd_amt AS double) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30' AND transaction_type = 'Withdrawals' AND transaction_catg NOT LIKE '%Total%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the highest system-wide hourly load in ERCOT's weather-zone forecasts?
Ercot Load Forecast By Weather Zone Cdr Lfcweathernp
SELECT max(try_cast(systemtotal AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.ercot_load_forecast_by_weather_zone_cdr_lfcweathernp
Which industries do prime awards that pass work to sub-awardees come from most often?
SELECT naics_description, count(*) AS subawards FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do public housing tenants pay in rent each month on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rent_per_month AS double))) AS avg_rent FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE program_label = 'Public Housing' AND try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) > 0
Which antipsychotic drugs are prescribed most under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, try_cast(tot_clms AS double) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND antpsyct_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of recorded solar installations change from 2012 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Where do families wait longest to get into subsidized housing?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(months_waiting AS double) AS months_waiting FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many links between candidates and their committees has the FEC recorded?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_committee_linkages
Which states had the most Medicare outpatient hospital services in 2023?
Medicare Outpatient Hospitals By Geography And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(capc_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_outpatient_hospitals_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND source_file LIKE '%DY23%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many atoms does the largest QM9 molecule contain?
SELECT max(natoms) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules
Which organisms are tested in the most ChEMBL assays?
SELECT assay_organism, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_organism IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many working residents did Puerto Rico have in 2007?
SELECT sum(c000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'pr' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2007
Which states have the most clinicians opted out of Medicare?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many skilled nursing facility cost reports were filed for fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_snf10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2025'
What kinds of defect investigation does NHTSA open most often?

SELECT CASE substr(c1, 1, 2) WHEN 'PE' THEN 'preliminary evaluation' WHEN 'EA' THEN 'engineering analysis' WHEN 'RQ' THEN 'recall query' WHEN 'DP' THEN 'defect petition' WHEN 'AQ' THEN 'audit query' ELSE substr(c1, 1, 2) END AS kind, count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the personal saving rate in April 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadatam WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020M04'
Which large cities have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS city, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_place WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND try_cast(totalpopulation AS double) >= 500000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many physics theses are recorded in INSPIRE?
SELECT count(*) AS theses FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE document_type LIKE '%thesis%'
Which Texas school districts run the most schools?
SELECT lea_name, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE st = 'TX' AND school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in import duties did the United States collect on goods arriving in 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cal_dut_mo AS double)) AS duties FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl WHERE year = '2024'
Which operating nuclear reactors have the largest generating capacity?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, try_cast(capacity_mwe AS double) AS mwe FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do SEC operating companies divide by filer status, from large accelerated filers down?

SELECT category, count(*) AS companies, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE entitytype = 'operating' AND category <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are hospitals filing fiscal 2023 cost reports owned: nonprofit, for-profit or government?

SELECT CASE WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('1', '2') THEN 'Nonprofit' WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') THEN 'For-profit' ELSE 'Government' END AS ownership, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_rpt WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly electricity demand on California's grid on March 18, 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.CISO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '20220318%'
Which organisations reported the most federal spending in their 2023 single audits?
SELECT auditee_name, try_cast(total_amount_expended AS double) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the latest reading in New York's real-time fuel mix?
SELECT max(date_parse(time_stamp, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS latest_reading FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix
Which states have the most active Davis-Bacon wage determinations?
SELECT states, count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'dbra' AND is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of CPSC product recalls change from 2010 to 2023?
SELECT substr(recalldate, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE substr(recalldate, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2023') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What kinds of generator have been built most since 2015?

SELECT technology, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE try_cast(operating_year AS integer) >= 2015 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many granted patents contributed reactions to the reaction set?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants
Which diseases have the most drugs approved or in clinical trials?
SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of registered studies are observational rather than interventional?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN study_type = 'OBSERVATIONAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_health.ct_studies
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most granted patents?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities in New York State reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _8_st = 'NY'
Which companies have filed the most patent lawsuits as plaintiff?
SELECT name, count(DISTINCT case_row_id) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_names WHERE party_type = 'Plaintiff' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Texas's voting-age citizens are Hispanic?

SELECT round(100.0 * max(CASE WHEN lntitle = 'Hispanic or Latino' THEN try_cast(cvap_est AS double) END) / max(CASE WHEN lntitle = 'Total' THEN try_cast(cvap_est AS double) END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE geoname = 'Texas'
What kinds of institution are listed in INSPIRE, and how many of each?
SELECT institution_type, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_institutions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many security interests in patents were recorded in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS security_interests FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment WHERE convey_text LIKE 'SECURITY%' AND substr(record_dt, 6, 4) = '2023'
How are judges' recorded party affiliations split?

SELECT CASE political_party WHEN 'd' THEN 'Democratic' WHEN 'r' THEN 'Republican' WHEN 'i' THEN 'Independent' WHEN 'f' THEN 'Federalist' WHEN 'w' THEN 'Whig' ELSE political_party END AS party, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_political_affiliations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Reactome reactions have a Rhea counterpart?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2reactome
Which stable materials in the Materials Project have the widest band gaps?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(band_gap AS double) AS band_gap_ev FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE try_cast(energy_above_hull AS double) = 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many preprints are in the ChemRxiv collection?
SELECT count(*) AS preprints FROM govblock_scholarly.chemrxiv_items
In which counties do subsidized households have the lowest average income?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(hh_income AS double) AS household_income FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(hh_income AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 500 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
How many EPA and state inspections have facilities in Ohio had over the last five years?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fac_inspection_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_state = 'OH'
Which countries are the first filing place for the most published U.S. applications?
SELECT foreign_country_filed AS country, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_foreign_priority GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Lockheed Martin or Boeing receive more federal contract dollars in fiscal 2023?

SELECT CASE WHEN upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE 'LOCKHEED MARTIN%' THEN 'Lockheed Martin' ELSE 'Boeing' END AS company, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND (upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE 'LOCKHEED MARTIN%' OR upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE '%BOEING%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
Which papers are cited most often by other papers in PubMed?
SELECT ref_pmid, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_health.pubmed_references WHERE ref_pmid <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Medicare pay for longer office visits (code 99214) in New York in 2019?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Geography And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_srvcs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc = 'New York' AND hcpcs_cd = '99214' AND source_file LIKE '%D19_Geo%'
At which hours of the day does Texas solar output peak, on average?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT hour_ending, round(avg(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How old is the average operating nuclear reactor?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(current_reactor_age AS double)), 1) AS avg_age_years FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1
Why do judges leave their posts, and how often for each reason?
SELECT termination_reason, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(termination_reason, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the oldest GAO report in the library about Medicare?
SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%medicare%' ORDER BY date LIMIT 5
At which companies did insiders give away the most shares as gifts in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double)) AS shares_gifted FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'G' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many babies were born in Manhattan hospitals in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Manhattan' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%newborn%' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which parent companies have the most affiliates registered as federal award recipients?
SELECT parent_legal_business_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE parent_legal_business_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of phase 3 trials started change from 2010 to 2024?

SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%' AND substr(start_date, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which universities received the most NIH funding in fiscal year 2024?
SELECT org_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of public housing households are headed by a woman, on average across projects?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(pct_female_head AS double)), 1) AS pct_female_head FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE program_label = 'Public Housing' AND try_cast(pct_female_head AS double) >= 0
Where are SEC operating companies most often incorporated?
SELECT stateofincorporation, count(*) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE entitytype = 'operating' AND stateofincorporation <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who owns U.S. patents: American companies, foreign companies, individuals or governments?

SELECT CASE cast(assignee_type AS varchar) WHEN '2' THEN 'U.S. company' WHEN '3' THEN 'foreign company' WHEN '4' THEN 'U.S. individual' WHEN '5' THEN 'foreign individual' WHEN '6' THEN 'U.S. federal government' WHEN '7' THEN 'foreign government' WHEN '8' THEN 'U.S. county government' WHEN '9' THEN 'U.S. state government' ELSE 'other' END AS owner_type, count(*) AS assignments, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which pollutants feature in the most EPA enforcement cases?
SELECT pollutant_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_pollutants WHERE pollutant_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did private-sector employment in Manhattan change from the first quarter of 2019 to the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT year, month3_emplvl AS employed FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36061' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2024') AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY year
At which companies did insiders put the most money into their own stock in 2020?

SELECT s.issuername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(t.trans_pricepershare AS double)) AS dollars_bought FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'P' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do pharmacies pay on average for one 20 mg atorvastatin tablet?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)), 4) AS cost_per_tablet FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac WHERE ndc_description LIKE 'ATORVASTATIN 20 MG TAB%' AND substr(effective_date, 7, 4) = '2024'
Which research institutions have published the most works, according to OpenAlex?
SELECT display_name, country_code, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the most U.S. nuclear capacity offline on any single day in 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS megawatts_out FROM govblock_energy.eia_nuc_status_data WHERE series_id = 'NUC_STATUS.OUT.US.D' AND period LIKE '2024%'
Which chemical systems have the most computed materials?
SELECT chemsys, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did natural gas power generation change from 2005 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.NG-US-99.A' AND period IN ('2005', '2024') ORDER BY 1
What are the largest single awards the National Science Foundation has ever made?
SELECT name, awardtitle, try_cast(awardamount AS double) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many oral argument recordings does the archive hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.oral_arguments
Which states had the cheapest electricity across all sectors in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.PRICE.%-ALL.A' AND length(series_id) = 19 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many children were hospitalized for asthma in the Bronx in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Bronx' AND age_group = '0 to 17' AND ccs_diagnosis_description = 'Asthma' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which states are home to the most federal award recipients?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average contribution a committee gave a federal candidate in 2024?
SELECT avg(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_fec.contributions_to_candidates WHERE transaction_dt LIKE '%2024'
Which patents have been asserted in the most lawsuits?
SELECT patent, count(DISTINCT case_row_id) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_patents WHERE patent <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the fair market rent for a two-bedroom home in Albany County, New York?

SELECT areaname, county_town_name, try_cast(fmr2 AS double) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'NY' AND countyname = 'Albany County' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
Which government forms run to the most pages?
SELECT form_number, title, try_cast(pages AS integer) AS pages FROM govblock_reference.forms ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many plant patents cover roses?
SELECT count(*) AS plant_patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_botanic WHERE latin_name LIKE 'Rosa%'
Which products did the United States export the most of in 2024?
SELECT comm_desc, sum(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_comm WHERE year = '2024' AND month = '12' AND comm_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal civil cases in the Integrated Database were filed in 2015?

SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_relationships WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many colleges are in Montgomery, Alabama?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unitid) AS institutions FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE city = 'MONTGOMERY' AND stabbr = 'AL'
Which states have the most hospices listed on Care Compare?
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT cms_certification_number_ccn) AS hospices FROM govblock_health.cc_hospice_provider WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did the Harbor Maintenance Trust Fund collect in fiscal 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS receipts FROM govblock_treasury.harbor_maintenance_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Receipts'
Which kinds of Treasury securities carried the highest average interest rate in September 2025?
SELECT security_desc, try_cast(avg_interest_rate_amt AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_treasury.avg_interest_rates WHERE record_date = '2025-09-30' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many metropolitan and how many micropolitan areas are there?
SELECT CASE cast(cbsa_type AS varchar) WHEN '1' THEN 'metropolitan' ELSE 'micropolitan' END AS kind, count(DISTINCT geoid) AS areas FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_cbsa GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which kinds of provider are most common among those enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT provider_type_desc, count(*) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many water system lead results came in above the 0.015 mg/L action level?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_lcr_samples WHERE contaminant_code = 'PB90' AND try_cast(sample_measure AS double) > 0.015
Which hospitals collect the most completed patient surveys?
SELECT facility_name, max(try_cast(number_of_completed_surveys AS double)) AS surveys FROM govblock_health.cc_hcahps_hospital WHERE facility_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did more U.S. exports to China go by air or by sea in 2018?
SELECT max(try_cast(air_val_yr AS double)) AS by_air, max(try_cast(ves_val_yr AS double)) AS by_vessel FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cty_name = 'CHINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2018'
Which kinds of emission sources account for the most reported greenhouse gases in 2023?

SELECT s.subpart_category, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_subpart AS s ON try_cast(s.subpart_id AS double) = try_cast(e.sub_part_id AS double) WHERE e.year = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trials of cancer immunotherapy are registered?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE lower(brief_title) LIKE '%immunotherapy%'
Which states consume the most natural gas?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.NGTCB.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many software packages from Energy Department research are on record?
SELECT count(*) AS software FROM govblock_research.osti_records WHERE product_type = 'Software'
Which dosage forms are most common among listed drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many medicinal-chemistry-like molecules does GDBMedChem list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdbmedchem
Which counties' hospitals handled the most discharges in 2016?
SELECT hospital_county, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND hospital_county IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Gene Ontology terms are mapped to Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2go
Which kinds of air permits are most common among EPA-tracked facilities?
SELECT caa_permit_types, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL AND caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many economically significant rules were on the fall 2024 regulatory agenda?
SELECT count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' AND priority_category LIKE 'Economically Significant%'
Which states are home to the most generator owners?
SELECT owner_state, count(DISTINCT owner_name) AS owners FROM govblock_energy.eia860_owner_y_sheet_ownership GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do states or EPA issue more informal enforcement actions over discharge permits?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which school districts received the most federal money in fiscal 2017?
SELECT name, stabbr, try_cast(tfedrev AS double) AS federal_revenue FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How do housing choice vouchers compare with public housing in total units nationwide?
SELECT program_label, sum(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE try_cast(total_units AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states generated the most nuclear power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.NUC-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which contaminants are behind the most drinking water violations?

SELECT r.value_description, count(DISTINCT v.violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement AS v JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_ref_code_values AS r ON r.value_code = v.contaminant_code AND r.value_type LIKE 'CONTAMINANT%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What hourly rate do Service Contract Act determinations set for janitors on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_sca_rates WHERE occupation_title LIKE 'Janitor%'
Which industry sectors paid the highest average wages nationwide in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.industry_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_industry_titles AS t ON t.industry_code = q.industry_code WHERE q.area_fips = 'US000' AND q.agglvl_code = '14' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many CPSC recalls cite a fire hazard?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE lower(hazards) LIKE '%fire%'
Which insurers file the most property and casualty rate changes in Texas?
SELECT company_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE company_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average net price for in-state students at the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor?
SELECT try_cast(npt4_pub AS double) AS net_price FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE instnm = 'University of Michigan-Ann Arbor'
Which states have the largest share of veterans among adults?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_veterans FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b21001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has average behind-the-meter solar output in central New York grown year by year?
SELECT substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) AS year, avg(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual WHERE zone_name = 'CENTRL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states have the most clinicians profiled in Open Payments?
SELECT covered_recipient_profile_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.op_covered_recipient_profile WHERE covered_recipient_profile_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of reactions found in granted patents change from 1980 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('1980', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What ranks of position are advertised most often in physics job listings?
SELECT ranks, count(*) AS jobs FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_jobs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the Henry Hub natural gas spot price on February 17, 2021?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mmbtu FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' AND period = '20210217'
Which classes of goods and services draw the most trademark filings?

SELECT CASE intl_class_cd WHEN '009' THEN '009 electronics and software' WHEN '025' THEN '025 clothing' WHEN '035' THEN '035 advertising and business' WHEN '041' THEN '041 education and entertainment' WHEN '042' THEN '042 science and technology services' WHEN '005' THEN '005 pharmaceuticals' WHEN '003' THEN '003 cosmetics and cleaning' WHEN '030' THEN '030 coffee, bread and staples' WHEN '016' THEN '016 paper and printed matter' WHEN '028' THEN '028 games and toys' WHEN '043' THEN '043 restaurants and hotels' WHEN '044' THEN '044 medical and beauty services' WHEN '036' THEN '036 finance and insurance' WHEN '021' THEN '021 housewares' WHEN '018' THEN '018 leather goods' WHEN '032' THEN '032 beer and soft drinks' WHEN '033' THEN '033 wine and spirits' ELSE intl_class_cd END AS class, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_intl_class GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What exchange rate did the Treasury set for the euro at the end of 2024?
SELECT try_cast(exchange_rate AS double) AS euros_per_dollar FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange WHERE country_currency_desc = 'Euro Zone-Euro' AND record_date = '2024-12-31'
Which journals have published the most articles?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources WHERE type = 'journal' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark registrations were cancelled during 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(reg_cancel_dt AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which kinds of cross-reference does ChEBI record most often?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_database_accession WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
